name: Influenza (Flu)
explanation: A contagious respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses that infect the nose, throat, and lungs.
treatment: Rest, fluids, antiviral medications if prescribed. OTC pain relievers for fever and aches.

name: Common Cold
explanation: A viral infection of the upper respiratory tract, usually caused by rhinoviruses.
treatment: Rest, stay hydrated, OTC decongestants and antihistamines for symptom relief.

name: COVID-19
explanation: A respiratory illness caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus, ranging from mild to severe.
treatment: Isolate, rest, fluids. Seek medical care if breathing difficulty occurs. Follow local health guidelines.

name: Pneumonia
explanation: An infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs, which may fill with fluid.
treatment: Antibiotics (bacterial), antiviral or antifungal medications. Hospitalization may be required.

name: Bronchitis
explanation: Inflammation of the bronchial tubes that carry air to and from the lungs.
treatment: Rest, fluids, humidifier. Antibiotics only if bacterial. Cough suppressants may help.

name: Gastroenteritis (Stomach Flu)
explanation: Inflammation of the stomach and intestines, typically caused by a viral or bacterial infection.
treatment: Stay hydrated with clear fluids. BRAT diet. Seek care if symptoms persist over 3 days.

name: Migraine
explanation: A neurological condition causing intense, debilitating headaches often with nausea and light sensitivity.
treatment: Rest in a dark quiet room. OTC pain relievers, triptans if prescribed. Identify and avoid triggers.

name: Hypertension (High Blood Pressure)
explanation: A condition where blood pressure in the arteries is persistently elevated, increasing risk of heart disease.
treatment: Lifestyle changes: low-sodium diet, exercise, no smoking. Medication as prescribed by doctor.

name: Type 2 Diabetes
explanation: A chronic condition affecting how the body processes blood sugar (glucose).
treatment: Diet control, exercise, blood sugar monitoring. Oral medications or insulin as prescribed.

name: Anemia
explanation: A condition where you lack enough healthy red blood cells to carry adequate oxygen to body tissues.
treatment: Iron supplements, vitamin B12, dietary changes. Treat underlying cause.

name: Appendicitis
explanation: Inflammation of the appendix causing severe abdominal pain, requiring immediate medical attention.
treatment: Emergency surgery (appendectomy) is typically required. Do not delay seeking care.

name: Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)
explanation: An infection in any part of the urinary system — kidneys, bladder, ureters, and urethra.
treatment: Antibiotics as prescribed. Drink plenty of water. Cranberry juice may help prevent recurrence.

name: Allergic Rhinitis (Hay Fever)
explanation: An allergic response causing cold-like symptoms triggered by allergens like pollen, dust, or pet dander.
treatment: Antihistamines, nasal corticosteroids, avoid triggers. Allergy shots for long-term relief.

name: Asthma
explanation: A condition where airways narrow and swell, producing extra mucus and making breathing difficult.
treatment: Inhalers (bronchodilators, corticosteroids). Avoid triggers. Follow asthma action plan.

name: Depression
explanation: A mood disorder causing persistent feelings of sadness and loss of interest affecting daily life.
treatment: Therapy (CBT), antidepressants if prescribed, exercise, social support. Seek professional help.
